binaryflow_static_arithmetic.status: own static arithmetic only; not masks/models/simulator reproduction
limits: Numerical tables can be internally consistent without proving the masks, weights, process model or wall-clock costs.
EPE here is sampled violation count, distinct from continuous edge displacement in nanometers.
